vocabularyUsageNote.nl:
This property contains the CRS code of the coordinate reference system used for the geometry.
A closed list of reference systems is supported: Lambert72, Lambert 2008, and WGS84.
Lambert72 is currently applied in practice (e.g. CRS code “3812”), while Lambert 2008 is included as the preferred target system in view of a planned transition.
